name: Na nedel'ku do vtorogo
source:
А short story about a young man who arrives in a quiet town of his childhood, in which, despite its apparent plainness, amazing, even mystical events take place. And the protagonist finds himself in the midst of these events.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4186480/]Steam[/url]]
